NONE: › past simple of the verb may, used especially when reporting what someone has said, thought, asked, etc.
A2 used to express the possibility that something will happen or be done, or that something is true although not very likely
› mainly UK formal US old-fashioned used as a more polite form of may when asking for permission
（用於請求許可，語氣較 may 更婉轉）可以，能
C1 used to make a suggestion or suggest a possibility in a polite way
› used to suggest, especially angrily, what someone should do to be pleasant, correct, polite, etc.
› also may used to introduce a statement that is very different from the statement you really want to make, in order to compare the two
（用於引出與真正想說的話完全不同的話，以將兩者對比）也許

example: I brought him some sandwiches because I thought he might be hungry.
我拿了些三明治給他，因為我想他可能餓了。
Very politely the little boy asked if he might have another piece of cake (= he said "May I have another piece of cake, please?").
小男孩非常禮貌地問可否再吃一塊蛋糕。
I might come and visit you next year, if I can save enough money.
如果我存夠錢的話，明年我也許會來看你。
Don't go any closer - it might be dangerous/it might not be safe.
別再走近了——那可能很危險／不安全。
Driving so fast, he might have had a nasty accident (= it could have happened but it did not).
他開車開得那麼快，早就可能出意外。
The rain might have stopped by now.
現在雨也許已經停了。
Might I ask a question?
我能問個問題嗎？
I wonder if I might have a quick look at your newspaper?
請問我能否看一下你的報紙？

NONE: › used in questions to show disapproval by being more polite than is expected
（用於問句中，禮貌地表示不贊同）我可以問一下／知道嗎

example: And what are you doing in there, might I ask?
我可以問一下你在那裡做甚麼嗎？

NONE: › If you might just as well do something, there are no reasons not to do it.

example: For the little extra it'll cost, we might just as well stay for another night.
只需多花一點錢，我們何不再住一晚呢？
She might've taken it with her to read on the plane.
她可能已經把它帶上飛機去讀了。

NONE: › something positive that could have been achieved, but was not
本來可能發生的事（本來有機會達成的好事，但卻沒有成真）

NONE: › a person that travels to a different country or place, often in order to find work
› biology an animal that moves from one place to another at different times of the year

› biology moving from one place to another at different times of year

example: The cities are full of migrants looking for work.
城市裡到處是尋找工作的移民。

這些鳥是從斯堪的納維亞遷徙過來的冬候鳥。

I: › [ I ] When an animal migrates, it travels to a different place, usually when the season changes.
› [ I ] If people migrate, they travel in large numbers to a new place to live temporarily.
（指人）大批外出；（暫時）移居，遷移
› [ I ] to move from one place to another

I or T: › [ I or T ] specialized computing to begin using a new computer system, or to move information from one type of system to another
轉移（使用新的作業系統，或將資料從一種作業系統移至另一種作業系統）

example: These animals migrate annually in search of food.
這些動物為尋找食物每年都遷徙。
In September, these birds migrate 2,000 miles south to a warmer climate.
九月，這些鳥會向南遷徙2000英里到更溫暖的地方。

每年收穫季節來臨時，大批墨西哥農場工人都會湧入美國找工作。

貿易正從當地的商店轉移到更大的連鎖商店。

改用 Windows XP 應該不會給你帶來任何不便。
